payout_quote: Amex High Yield Savings Account: 3.00% APY per Amex's own savings calculator ('Your potential interest earned after 1 years with 3.00 apy is $15'). 'Potential interest earned using today's rates. Rates are variable and can change at any time.' 'Interest is compounded daily and credited to your account monthly.' 'No fee to open, no minimum deposit, and no monthly fees.' FDIC-insured: each depositor insured to at least $250,000. This is interest on your own deposits, not a signup bonus.
timing: No signup bonus exists. Interest is compounded daily and credited to the account monthly. External-account linking can take up to two days.
eligibility: Complete the online application with contact information, proof of address, Social Security number, and date of birth. Amex verifies identification against public records (no credit impact). Confirmation email, then register the online account.
biggest_catch: There is no signup bonus — the only 'payout' is variable interest on your own deposits, and the 3.00% APY is variable and can change at any time.
catches: No signup bonus exists on americanexpress.com — the only 'payout' is variable interest on your own deposits.
The 3.00% APY is variable and can change at any time.
Linking an external bank account can take up to two days before funding completes.
No Amex card is required to open the HYSA — the catalog's 'may require Amex card' catch is not supported by Amex's official page.
steps: Go to https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/banking/online-savings/high-yield-savings-account/ and start the application.
Provide contact information, proof of address, Social Security number, and date of birth; Amex verifies your identity (no credit impact).
Receive the confirmation email and register your online account.
Fund by depositing a check via mobile, transferring from an Amex Rewards Checking account, or linking your current bank (linking can take up to two days), or mail a check.
Keep funds parked; interest compounds daily and is credited monthly at the variable APY.
